title: Generative
description:
Generative music through MIDI manipulation. A single MIDI source routes messages to multiple tracks, each with cascaded arpeggiators running at different note lengths and extensions, so one chord triggers a whole hierarchy of devices at different intervals, lengths, and voicings. Two hooks with automation shape the sound over time, meant to mimic a sound design installation where sensors modify parameters in real time.

The project ended up in dark ambient territory, so I leaned into that. Dissociation comes from layering in noise that gradually drowns out the original tracks. Anxiety comes from increasing delay repetitions on the active MIDI parts while shifting stereo panning sends accelerating elements bouncing around the listener.
